subject: is it possible to construct nested navbarMenus?

messages.author: e6d426c9552b1af9
messages.subject: is it possible to construct nested navbarMenus?
parts:
Hi,

I was wondering if it is possible to nest navbarMenu items to construct a hierarchical menu, say something like this:

navbarMenu("Menu 1" ,  
   tabPanel("option 1"),
   navbarMenu("option 2" ,
      tabPanel("A"),
      tabPanel("B"))
)

No errors appear when running an app with such code, however, the nested part doesn't work :-(

Is there any way using Shiny to construct such menu options?

I found this, however, it appears to be in the context of Boostrap 3, without Shiny.

kind regards, Herman
